# namespace_tenant_group (Resource)

Manages a Namespace Cloud IAM tenant group. Tenant groups bundle policy configurations applied across enrolled tenants. Exclusive ownership semantics apply: tenant group configuration uses a non-atomic Describe + Ensure lifecycle without optimistic concurrency revision locking, resulting in last-writer-wins behavior. To prevent race conditions and unintended configuration overwrites, tenant groups should be managed exclusively by Terraform without concurrent out-of-band writers. Namespace rejects deletion while tenants remain enrolled; unenroll every tenant before destroying the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

# Note: Managing tenant groups requires Partner Token credentials
resource "namespace_tenant_group" "production" {
  name = "production-workspaces"

  policies = [
    {
      policy = "namespace.cloud.compute.v1beta.UsagePolicy"
      value = jsonencode({
        max_cpus   = 128
        max_memory = 524288
      })
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the tenant group. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `policies` (Attributes List) List of policy configurations attached to the tenant group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

### Read-Only

- `enrolled_tenant_ids` (List of String) List of tenant IDs enrolled in this tenant group.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for the tenant group in Terraform state, matching the group name.

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Required:

- `policy` (String) Fully qualified policy identifier type (e.g. `namespace.cloud.compute.v1beta.UsagePolicy`).
- `value` (String) JSON or string-serialized policy configuration payload.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the tenant group name. Partner credentials are required.
terraform import namespace_tenant_group.production production-workspaces
```
